meta: Ask AI to read a rental contract or an electricity bill and explain it in plain words. Day 3 of the 7-day AI challenge.

muc.title: Day 3: confusing paperwork
muc.text: Day three of seven: you've read your rental contract three times and still don't get it. Ask AI to say it in plain words.

muc.title: Hide personal details
muc.text: Before pasting, cover your name, ID number and bank account. AI only needs the terms.

muc.title: Explain each clause
muc.text: Ask AI to explain each clause simply and point out anything about penalties or getting your deposit back.

muc.title: Questions for the landlord
muc.text: Then ask AI to list questions to ask the landlord before you sign. AI is not a lawyer, so for big decisions ask an expert.

muc.title: Day 3 task
muc.text: Cover the customer number on an electricity bill, send a photo to a chatbot and ask it to explain each line.
